name: Uses IP Address
description: This interface is configured with this address: the address is bound to the interface by its host's operating system or, for a cloud instance, assigned to it by the provider. A reference, not containment: an ip_address is shared across observers in its network and can move to another interface, so it does not retire with the interface (req-computing-core-interface-4). A loopback address is never an ip_address and draws no such edge; it is the host's own loopback_address.
